prompt:
The section sections/app-promo-platforms.liquid currently prints the heading, every feature block and both store links unconditionally. The schema already defines a `platform` setting and a per-block `platforms` setting, but the markup ignores them. Wire them up using exact, case-sensitive matching. Keep the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs. The only top-level variable is `section`. All keys are always present. - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.platform: string or null. - section.settings.ios_url: string or null. - section.settings.android_url: string or null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each element is {"settings": {"text": string or null, "platforms": string or null}}. `platforms` is a comma-separated list. Rules. 1. Effective platform. If section.settings.platform is exactly "ios", "android" or "all", that is the effective platform. Comparison is case-sensitive with no trimming. Any other value is treated as "all", including null, "", "iOS", "ALL" and " android". 2. Heading. Strip the heading. If the result is non-empty, output

HEADING

with the text HTML-escaped. 3. Features. Split a block's `platforms` on "," into tokens. Tokens are NOT trimmed and are compared exactly and case-sensitively; null or "" yields no tokens. Note that the whole string must not be substring-matched ("androidx" does not match "android"). A block is shown when its stripped text is non-empty and at least one of these holds: - the effective platform is "all"; - one of its tokens equals the effective platform; - one of its tokens equals "all". If at least one block is shown, output
    containing
  • TEXT
    • for each shown block, in block order, with the stripped text HTML-escaped. Otherwise output no ul. 4. Stores. App Store is eligible when the effective platform is "ios" or "all" and the stripped ios_url is non-empty. Google Play is eligible when the effective platform is "android" or "all" and the stripped android_url is non-empty. If either is eligible, output
    containing, in this order: - App Store, if eligible; - Google Play, if eligible. The href uses the stripped URL, HTML-escaped. Otherwise output no stores div. 5. Wrapper. Always output
    . It contains, in order, the h2, the ul and the stores div (each only when applicable). 6. Escaping turns & < > " into & < > ". The output must contain no whitespace or newlines between tags or around text. Use whitespace control. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/app-promo-platforms.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
